annotation.bound_parties_text: The regulations bind owners and operators of unmanned aircraft systems, persons operating them, observers, and unmanned aircraft clubs, and also the Civil Aviation Authority.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: These Regulations shall apply to any– (a) unmanned aircraft system, as defined in these Regulations, to be operated within the territory of Trinidad and Tobago; (b) person operating an unmanned aircraft system
annotation.dates_quote: Made by the Trinidad and Tobago Civil Aviation Authority this 21st day of October, 2016.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: THE CIVIL AVIATION [(NO. 19) UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SYSTEMS] REGULATIONS, 2016
